messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER -> metering.prod: token-count drift detected (token_delta > 5% over 3 windows). Affected shards: shard-7..shard-10. Severity: high. Auto-page oncall.
oncall-ryan: I'm oncall, looking. ETA 10m. Which pipeline is emitting the discrepancy?
ingest-elaine: prod-kafka -> emitter service. Seeing consumer lag on consumer-group `ingest-prod-group`. Quick compare shows ingress vs billing delta for last hour.
ingest-elaine: ```sql
-- quick counts (postgres)
SELECT sum(tokens) as tokens FROM prod_ingest.metrics WHERE ts >= now() - interval '1 hour';
-- result: tokens: 1,201,342
```
billing-maya: billing snapshot at 10:12Z shows ~1,506,890 tokens billed for same window (approx +25%). Several orgs flagged for overage: org-113, org-298, org-444. Support started receiving alerts.
sre-jordan: running reconciliation script now: `./tools/reconcile_tokens.sh --start "2026-03-17T09:00Z" --end "2026-03-17T10:00Z" --dry-run`
sre-jordan: script failing on shard-8 consumer checkpoint read: `ERROR: checkpoint mismatch: expected 23452345, got null` — looks like checkpoint persistence didn't succeed for a subset of emitters.
oncall-ryan: good find. I'm going to do a rolling restart of emitter instances for shard-8 then shard-9. Will coordinate with ingress.
oncall-ryan: @ingest-elaine please confirm rollbacks are safe for emitter restarts (no double-process).
ingest-elaine: confirmed — restart has idempotent checkpoint resume. I'll watch for replays.
oncall-ryan: restarting emitter shard-8 now (cmd: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/emitter-shard-8 -n prod`)
incident-bot: Deploy bot: rollout restart deployment/emitter-shard-8 completed in 18s by oncall-ryan.
oncall-ryan: restart done at 6512345720. Monitoring metrics.
ingest-elaine: post-restart counts (next 5m) look aligned. Quick check:
```
ingest> sum(emitted_tokens) over last 5m: 203,112
billing> billed_tokens last 5m: 205,005
delta: ~0.93% (within threshold)
```
billing-maya: temporary mitigation: clearing overage flags for listed orgs and opening manual billing hold while we reconcile. Notifying support and account owners (@support-liz).
support-liz: acknowledged — support message template queued to affected orgs, will hold billing until reconciliation finishes.
sre-jordan: reconciliation run succeeded after restart. Backfill job enqueued: `jobs/backfill_token_counts --range 2026-03-17T09:00Z/2026-03-17T10:00Z --shards 7-10` (ETA 45m).
oncall-ryan: lowering pager severity. Creating follow-up action items: INC-8972 (live mitigation notes) and PM-1423 (postmortem for checkpoint persistence). Assigning to ingest-elaine + sre-jordan.
ingest-elaine: noted. Will add logs + config diff to INC-8972.
billing-maya: action: rollback automated overage emails, refund hold for affected invoices if needed. Coordinate with finance.
incident-bot: Alert status: mitigated -> monitoring. Reopen if drift > 2% in next 2 windows.
oncall-ryan: closing runbook incident in Slack. Thanks team. Follow-up: postmortem in 48h, runbook update to add checkpoint verification step before deploys.
